newspec-b: failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））
Re-run 17:05. Hospital (fail; and the 65 s hang): the error shows (after ~0.9 s; on the hang after ~65–67 s, with 'Updating structured summary…' during the wait), but the stored points are already 'Call ID re cultures', 'Check drain site', 'Draft: ask about home O2' and the draft is '' — the case-only twin 'call ID re cultures' is dropped and the draft is turned into a card before the model call, and it stays so after the retry. Nursing Home with the matrix's seed (a points list plus a separate one-line draft, a state the NH editor never writes): all three points replaced by one card 'Draft: ask about dentures'. Nursing Home with the draft shape its own editor writes (the whole box): text and order kept, ids re-issued, the draft line becomes a card (Q4).
产品问题: Save Note rewrites the Important Points before the AI call, so they change even when the summary fails: Hospital drops a point that differs only in case ('call ID re cultures') and turns the unsaved draft into a card; Nursing Home re-issues the ids. Fails TC-12 U11/T5 and TFA-92590 AC 2/4 as the oracle words them (points identical, draft kept); what the physician notices is minor. Question for Daniela (with TC-12/S19): do ids belong in the U3/T5 check for Nursing Home?

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B20 · P1 · 已知

Save Note 会改写重点事项：AI 失败时也已经改了（只差大小写的那条被删、没保存的草稿变成卡片）；养老院每次保存都重建 id

票：TFA-92590 in progress · 算 QA bug：否（票在做） · 在哪发现：本地

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-12/S19

思路 / Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S28 「Save Note 的 AI 调用失败或卡住：要点和没保存的草稿完全保留（两个模式）」 Save Note's AI call fails or hangs: the points and the unsaved draft are kept exactly (both modes)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U11 If Save Note's AI call fails or is slow, nothing the physician typed is lost: the points stay exactly as they were (ids, text, order), an unsaved points draft is kept, and a clear message shows (the …（UAT 3.5；UAT Empty & Failure States；UAT TC-10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point.（UAT TC-12；TFA-92590 AC 2；TFA-92590 description） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • T5 Points are stored exactly as typed: text, case, punctuation, symbols and spacing, one card per typed point, nothing added. Deterministic: any single mismatch fails and is quoted typed vs stored; …（TFA-92590 AC 4；TFA-92590 description） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes.（UAT TC-12；UAT 3.3；TFA-92590 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, each seeded with three points (including a case-only pair) and an unsaved points draft

When Make the pre-round parse action (ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes, and the Nursing Home parse) (a) throw on the first call, (b) hang past the timeout; type a note and tap Save Note; then retry (or let the fallback run) until it succeeds

Then After the failure, and again after the retry succeeds: the stored list is identical to the seed (ids, text, order; the case-only pair still two points); the draft is kept while it failed; an explicit error is shown, never a silent wait

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.5 (retry, backup model or a clear message; never left waiting), Empty & Failure States ('Pre-round summary failed: raw dictation kept, error shown'; 'Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost'), TFA-92590 AC 2 / AC 4. Judged on a backend read after the failure: importantPoints == seed (ids, text, order) and importantPointsDraft == the seeded draft; …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-b（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 FAULT · 故障注入；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S28 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-12.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92590 in progress

Save Note 的 AI 调用失败或卡住时，Important Points 已经被改写：医院里只差大小写的那条被删、没保存的草稿变成卡片，养老院按编辑框重建卡片。

When Save Note's AI call fails or hangs, the Important Points have already been rewritten. In Hospital a point that differs only in case is dropped and the unsaved draft becomes a card; Nursing Home re-creates the cards from the editor box.

依据：allure 38c5588d: the error does show (after 1.4 s, or about 68 s on a 65 s hang), but the stored list has already changed and stays changed after the retry. TC-12 matrix knownGaps record the Hospital case-insensitive de-dup (uniquePoints, TFA-92590 AC 4 / Q6) and the NH rebuild from the box. TC-12 risks list the rewrite-before-the-AI-call order. The draft becoming a card is TC-12 Q4 (Daniela).

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-b。

测试方法：FAULT · 故障注入；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：newspec-b。

UAT item: TC-12 Important Points · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-12/S28

Save Note's AI call fails or hangs: the points and the unsaved draft are kept exactly (both modes)

Tickets: TFA-92590 Important Points (in progress)

本地新 lane newspec-b：newspec-b/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（newspec-b/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Chromium spec per mode: seed three points (incl. the case-only pair) and an unsaved points draft; (a) parse fails on first call; (b) parse held past the client's wait (hold at the socket, then fail like a timeout); type the note, Save Note; backend read after the failure (points == seed, draft == seeded draft, error visible); then retry until success and read again. — Fault and hang injected at the socket; the backend read is the physician's own JWT.

Detail:

Re-run 17:05. Hospital (fail; and the 65 s hang): the error shows (after ~0.9 s; on the hang after ~65–67 s, with 'Updating structured summary…' during the wait), but the stored points are already 'Call ID re cultures', 'Check drain site', 'Draft: ask about home O2' and the draft is '' — the case-only twin 'call ID re cultures' is dropped and the draft is turned into a card before the model call, and it stays so after the retry. Nursing Home with the matrix's seed (a points list plus a separate one-line draft, a state the NH editor never writes): all three points replaced by one card 'Draft: ask about dentures'. Nursing Home with the draft shape its own editor writes (the whole box): text and order kept, ids re-issued, the draft line becomes a card (Q4).

产品问题：Save Note rewrites the Important Points before the AI call, so they change even when the summary fails: Hospital drops a point that differs only in case ('call ID re cultures') and turns the unsaved draft into a card; Nursing Home re-issues the ids. Fails TC-12 U11/T5 and TFA-92590 AC 2/4 as the oracle words them (points identical, draft kept); what the physician notices is minor. Question for Daniela (with TC-12/S19): do ids belong in the U3/T5 check for Nursing Home?

证据：附了 5 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our scripted spec, not written yet): action-observer failFirst / a hang on the pre-round parse actions, and a seed through the local admin helpers; dev has no admin key and no action mock, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
